outputs.explanation: Panel A shows super-resolution micrograph reconstructions (localizations, density map, 3D localizations, cluster segmentation) — not a plot of averaged data, so the individual-data-points check does not apply.
Panel B shows super-resolution micrograph reconstructions for PacL2, same as panel A — not a plot of averaged data.
Scatter plot of number of clusters per cell shows mean ± SEM overlaid with individual gray dots representing single cells.
Scatter plot of cluster sizes (log scale) shows mean ± SEM overlaid with individual gray dots representing single clusters.
Scatter plot of the proportion of clustered molecules per cell shows mean ± SEM overlaid with individual gray dots representing single cells.
Panel F shows sptPALM micrographs and trajectory overlays, not a plot of averaged/aggregated data.
Top is a histogram of diffusion coefficients (counts) and bottom is a line plot of mean square displacement per trajectory; both plot types are exempt from requiring overlaid individual points.
Panel H shows trajectory maps and a kymograph — image-based single-molecule tracking data, not a summary plot of averages.
